licence: GPL-3.0 (licence.txt line 2; no per-file header in InvalidationGrid.h/.cpp, as read)
best_idea: Track screen damage as a grid of 128 px blocks, redraw only the merged dirty rectangles, and scan only the bounding box of changed blocks, so an unchanged HUD costs nothing per frame.
decision_why: Keep the block grid and rectangle merge for the client HUD canvas only; the 3D fight view moves every frame, so it is not a dirty-rect candidate. Client-only, engine untouched.
acceptance: A unit test on the grid (no GPU) asserts a health change on one HUD bar emits only the rectangles covering that bar and a frame with no HUD change emits zero rectangles; in play a 60 s idle fight at 375 wide repaints the HUD layer only when a value changes.
